mainVideo.title: Sign Language Class — Lesson 1: Learn 60 Sentences
mainVideo.description: Learn basic sign language sentences with our expert instructor. Perfect for beginners who want to communicate without words. Part of the 'I Am Here' film campaign.

playlist.title: Lesson 1: The Language of Silence
playlist.description: Learn basic sign language sentences with our expert instructor. Perfect for beginners who want to communicate without words. Part of the 'I Am Here' film campaign.

playlist.description: Master daily greetings, welcoming gestures, and morning/evening expressions in Indian Sign Language.

playlist.description: Express family connections, relationships, and heartfelt bonds through gentle finger movements.

playlist.description: Discover how joy, warmth, comfort, and longing are conveyed through facial expressions and hand signs.

playlist.description: Common everyday activities, gratitude expressions, asking questions, and workplace communication.

playlist.description: Fluency practice, storytelling without voice, poetry in motion, and building deep conversational links.
